generatedProtocol.note: Generated against a Codex Desktop runtime that is no longer the runtime this repository spawns; the hash is retained as a historical observation and does not describe codex-cli 0.133.0.

relationNote: The installed runtime and generated protocol were observed together; no evidence proves that runtime was built from the recorded source commit.
environmentNote: Under the packaged Claude desktop app, writes to %LOCALAPPDATA%/Crossline are redirected by Windows to the package LocalCache (Packages/Claude_pzs8sxrjxfjjc/LocalCache/Local). A codex-home created from such a session is therefore not the codex-home a normally started Windows worker reads, so isolated-home login must be verified from a non-packaged shell.
